findings.title: Missing rate limiting on token endpoint
findings.description: The token endpoint does not enforce rate limiting, allowing an attacker to brute-force client credentials.
findings.remediation: Add rate limiting or account lockout on the token endpoint.
findings.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

findings.title: Verbose error messages
findings.description: Error responses leak internal implementation details that can help an attacker map the authorization server.
findings.remediation: Return generic error messages to clients and log details server-side instead.
findings.cwe_name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
